description: Four-rooms check of the cube induced-reward effect; see the docstring of tools/diag_fourrooms_induced_reward.py for every definition. Means are over 8 goals, then mean and std over seeds.

exact.note: rho is uniform; each (cell, action) pair counted once in the reward fit and the Q-iteration. feat readout: least squares of the 0/1 reward on the action-averaged exact measure (104 features for 104 cells), so it is close to the true reward.
